info.name: DEFXC API v1
info.description:
DEFXC Financial Platform API - wallet-first refactor.

## Quick Start
1. Generate/import a wallet mnemonic (folder 03).
2. Use the returned wallet token ({{token}}) to call Register Profile (folder 01), or Complete Profile.
3. Paste the email OTP into {{otp}} and run Verify OTP.
4. Financial routes (dashboard, deposits, withdrawals, transfers, card requests) are open to any authenticated wallet — profile registration and email verification are NOT required to reach them (onboarding gate is intentionally disabled). Register Profile / Verify OTP are only needed if you want a proper user identity (username, email, referrals, password login) attached to the wallet.

## Auth Model
- Wallet mnemonic/fingerprint is the primary identity, issued as a Sanctum bearer token.
- Email/username/password login (Login) is backup/recovery only, for wallets already linked to a user.
- {{token}} is set automatically by the test scripts on Login, Register Profile, Verify OTP, Wallet Verify, and Wallet Import.
- Admin actions are handled through Blade admin routes, not this API.

## Storage
- Wallets store mnemonic_hash, fingerprint, and public_key. Plaintext mnemonics are never stored server-side after generation.
- Transactions, card requests, and wallet connections are all linked to wallet_id (not user_id) — a wallet is the account; the user record is the linked profile/identity on top of it.

## Folders
00 Reference Data · 01 Auth · 02 Password Reset · 03 Wallet Setup · 04 Dashboard & Assets ·
05 Profile · 06 Transactions · 07 Deposits · 08 Withdrawals · 09 Transfers · 10 Card Requests ·
11 Public · 12 Admin Actions (placeholder) · 13 Validation Errors (sample failure cases)


## Onboarding Gate — Intentionally Disabled
Profile completion / email verification are no longer required to access the dashboard,
deposits, withdrawals, transfers, or card requests — a bare wallet identity (straight out of
Wallet Setup) can hit all of those routes immediately. This is intentional, not a bug.
The X-Profile-Completed and X-Email-Verified response headers are still sent on every
authenticated response but are currently hardcoded to "true" and don't reflect real state —
don't gate frontend UI on them.
